title: Localization of actual semilinear transitions
statement:
For m≤n the strict transition of evaluation at n to restriction of evaluation at m descends to a natural transformation on unbounded derived categories. Its cochain representative equation is exactly evaluation factorization at n followed by localization of the original strict transition, after the two exact target factorizations.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
theorem systemDerivedTransition_rep {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (K : CochainComplex (StrictRingSystem B) ℤ) :
    (systemDerivedTransition B h).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      (systemRestriction B h).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((systemEvaluation B m).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K) ≫
      (systemRestriction B h).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        (((systemEvaluation B m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) =
    (systemEvaluation B n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((strictSystemTransition B h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) |>.app K)
```

proof.text: Lift the strict cochain natural transformation through localization and compose with the exact functor compositor for evaluation followed by scalar restriction. Apply the formula for localization of a natural transformation and the exact compositor factorization. The inverse factorization cancels its forward map.
